regions.name: Greenreach
regions.description: A quiet frontier of thatched villages, old roads, and woods that remember older names.

locations.name: Thornbury Village
locations.description: A market village of timber and stone. The guild board stands beside the well.

locations.name: The Old Road
locations.description: A moss-grown trade road. Wagons once crossed here; now only hoofprints and rumours.

locations.name: Whispering Wood
locations.description: Birch and bramble press close. Something moves between the trunks.

locations.name: Harvest Fields
locations.description: Striped furrows run toward the treeline. Scarecrows stand guard over empty ground.

locations.name: Barrow Hill
locations.description: A bald hill crowned with leaning stones. The grass grows thin over old graves.

regions.name: Ashen March
regions.description: A grey frontier of burned fields, broken walls, and things that do not sleep.

locations.name: The Ashen Gate
locations.description: A blackened gatehouse half-swallowed by the march. Cold air drifts through it.

locations.name: Ruined Watchtower
locations.description: A broken tower on a bald hill. Its beacon has been dark for a generation.

locations.name: Ember Fords
locations.description: Shallow water runs warm over black stones. The crossing hisses underfoot.

locations.name: The Bonefield
locations.description: A plain of broken spears and pale shards. Nothing has been buried here for years.

locations.name: Cinder Shrine
locations.description: A squat stone shrine crusted with soot. Offerings of ash sit before a faceless idol.

regions.name: Frostmere
regions.description: A highland lake country of grey water, frozen reeds, and chapels built for a faith that left.

locations.name: Frostmere Shore
locations.description: Grey water laps at a shingle beach. Reeds stand frozen in the shallows.

locations.name: The Frozen Jetty
locations.description: A rotting pier extends into the lake, its pilings sheathed in clear ice.

locations.name: Rimewood
locations.description: Black pines carry white frost all year. Tracks in the snow do not belong to deer.

locations.name: The Ice Chapel
locations.description: A stone chapel roofed with frozen rain. Hymns seem to hang in the cold air.

locations.name: The Drowned Barrow
locations.description: A burial mound half-submerged in the mere. Pale roots twist through its stones.

regions.name: Sunken Coast
regions.description: A drowned shoreline of broken harbours, salt marsh, and lights that move beneath the tide.

locations.name: Tidewreck Harbor
locations.description: Shattered quays and beached hulls mark a harbour the sea has reclaimed.

locations.name: The Salt Marsh
locations.description: Channels of brine cut through grey mud. Something heavy drags itself between the reeds.

locations.name: The Drowned Lighthouse
locations.description: Only the top of the tower shows above the water. Its lamp still burns green at night.

locations.name: Smuggler Coves
locations.description: Sea caves hide old crates and newer footprints. A narrow stair climbs toward the hills.

locations.name: Leviathan Shoal
locations.description: Black bones break the surface at low tide. The water between them is very still.

regions.name: Emberdeep
regions.description: A volcanic hollow of slag hills, old forges, and a market that never sees daylight.

locations.name: The Ember Gate
locations.description: A basalt arch breathes warm air from the dark. Chains hang slack across its threshold.

locations.name: Cinder Market
locations.description: Stalls of black iron crowd a cavern lit by lava channels. Nobody asks where the goods came from.

locations.name: The Forge Halls
locations.description: Rows of cold anvils stretch into the smoke. Something still works the bellows.

locations.name: The Slag Pits
locations.description: Terrace after terrace of cooling rock. Hound tracks circle the rim.

locations.name: The Magma Core
locations.description: A lake of slow fire lights a cathedral of stone. The heat presses the breath from your lungs.

regions.name: The Hollow Crown
regions.description: A dead kingdom of glass fields and silent courts, where an empty throne still expects tribute.

locations.name: The Crown Threshold
locations.description: A road of white stone crosses a plain of shattered glass toward a distant palace.

locations.name: The Glass Fields
locations.description: Acres of fused glass reflect a sky that never changes. Footsteps ring like bells.

locations.name: The Silent Court
locations.description: A colonnade of pale statues surrounds a dry fountain. None of the faces are finished.

locations.name: The Reliquary
locations.description: Sealed cases line a vault of black marble. Something inside each one is still moving.

locations.name: The Empty Throne
locations.description: A crown of rusted iron hangs above a seat of glass. The hall waits for a ruler who never returns.
